title: T 形电阻二端口的 Z 参数
statement: 图示 T 形电阻二端口中，R_1 = 2 Ω，R_2 = 3 Ω，R_3 = 4 Ω。端口电压 u_1、u_2 的“+”分别在 1、2 端，端口电流 i_1、i_2 分别从 1、2 端流入（关联参考方向）。
Z 参数方程：u_1 = z_11·i_1 + z_12·i_2，u_2 = z_21·i_1 + z_22·i_2。按定义（令另一端口开路）求 Z 参数。

questions.explain: i_2 = 0 时 R_2 上无压降，u_2 等于 R_3 上的电压 4·i_1，所以 z_21 = u_2/i_1 = 4 Ω。

questions.ask: 不用再算，z_12 等于多少？
questions.explain: i_1 = 0 时 R_1 无电流，u_1 = R_3·i_2，z_12 = 4 Ω = z_21。只由线性电阻（无受控源）构成的二端口是互易的，总有 z_12 = z_21。

hints: Z 参数又叫开路阻抗参数：求 z_11、z_21 时令 i_2 = 0（2–2' 开路），在 1–1' 加电流 i_1。
端口开路时与它串联的电阻里没有电流，也没有压降；z_11、z_21 只和 R_1、R_3 有关。

en.title: Z parameters of a resistive T network
statement: In the resistive T two-port, R_1 = 2 Ω, R_2 = 3 Ω, R_3 = 4 Ω. The port voltages u_1, u_2 are + at terminals 1 and 2, and the port currents i_1, i_2 flow into terminals 1 and 2 (passive convention).
Z-parameter equations: u_1 = z_11·i_1 + z_12·i_2, u_2 = z_21·i_1 + z_22·i_2. Find the Z parameters from their definitions (with the other port open).

questions.explain: With 2–2' open (i_2 = 0) there is no current in R_2, so port 1 sees R_1 in series with R_3: z_11 = u_1/i_1 = 2 + 4 = 6 Ω.
With i_2 = 0 there is no drop across R_2, so u_2 equals the voltage across R_3, 4·i_1: z_21 = u_2/i_1 = 4 Ω.
With 1–1' open (i_1 = 0), port 2 sees R_2 in series with R_3: z_22 = 3 + 4 = 7 Ω.

questions.ask: Without further calculation, what is z_12?
questions.explain: With i_1 = 0 there is no current in R_1, so u_1 = R_3·i_2 and z_12 = 4 Ω = z_21. A two-port made only of linear resistors (no dependent sources) is reciprocal, so z_12 = z_21 always.

hints: Z parameters are the open-circuit impedance parameters: for z_11 and z_21 set i_2 = 0 (port 2 open) and drive port 1 with a current i_1.
A resistor in series with an open port carries no current and has no voltage drop; z_11 and z_21 involve only R_1 and R_3.
solution: **1. Set i_2 = 0 (2–2' open) and drive port 1 with i_1.** R_2 carries no current, so i_1 flows through R_1 and R_3:
**2. Set i_1 = 0 (1–1' open) and drive port 2 with i_2.** R_1 carries no current:
**3. Result:** Z = [6 4; 4 7] Ω. z_12 = z_21 = R_3 (the shared branch), so the network is reciprocal; z_11 ≠ z_22, so it is not symmetric.
